normativeDefinition: A substance represented as an amount composed of many small particles.

necessary: A candidate must satisfy this concept-specific identity condition: A substance represented as an amount composed of many small particles.
Its substance identity must persist independently of temporary state, contextual role, visual style, and realization form.
excludes: A candidate whose primary identity belongs to an upper sort other than substance is excluded.
A candidate related only by part, membership, location, attachment, support, temporary state, treatment, or contextual role is excluded.
